>>> xpr ::  Psh2DebianLinux [260913]  
    
1.  Install wget if not already present
    bash$>  sudo apt-get install -y wget

2.  Download the latest stable release (adjust version URL as needed)
    bash$>  wget https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell/releases/download/v7.6.6/powershell-lts_7.6.6-1.deb_amd64.deb

3.  Install the package
    bash$>  sudo dpkg -i powershell-lts_7.6.6-1.deb_amd64.deb

4.  Resolve any missing dependencies automatically
    bash$>  sudo apt-get install -f    

5.  Launch PowerShell
    bash$>  pwsh 
    
6.  exit PowerShell
    pwsh$>  exit
